correctness.rationale: The Rule-54 local truth table yields the exact four-state Boolean predecessor relations T0=(1,8,0,12), T1=(2,4,3,0). Each classical forbidden block annihilates the relation, proving necessity. The 13-state proper-prefix automaton captures all cyclic avoidance words; an exhaustive closure over its state, the 4x4 relation product and a length counter capped at two checks that every returning walk of length >=2 has a positive relation diagonal. This is an all-length finite-state certificate, not a finite-word cutoff: 1322 distinct triples were visited across the 13 origins. Ring length one is handled separately and yields only output zero. The 13 exact integer transfer traces and Newton identities give det(I-zA)=(1+z^2)(1-2z+z^3-z^4), hence the all-length logarithmic-derivative image enumerator with the one-cell correction. All possible rings through length 16 were independently enumerated; the self-contained standard-library verifier prints VERIFY_OK. The direct census only corroborates the all-length arguments.

originality.rationale: The four forbidden blocks of the bi-infinite Rule-54 image were proved previously by Jen (1989); they are used as input, not claimed as new. The new statement determines exactly when those constraints admit an input with the same prescribed ring period and enumerates every periodic-ring image size, including the nontrivial period-one exception. The inspected original Jen proposition concerns allowed factors and not periodic lifting. Rule-54 glider/de Bruijn diagrams in Martínez–Adamatzky–McIntosh and the general decidability framework in Salo do not supply the explicit all-ring criterion and rational count in the inspected passages. Mathematically adjacent Rule-184 and Rule-110 image enumerations concern different local maps. Remaining risk is an unindexed historical exact image count or a result buried in an older CA table.
residual_risks: Historical priority is not independently established; less accessible older Rule54 finite-state/tabulation papers might contain an equivalent formula.

value.rationale: Rule 54 is a canonical nonlinear elementary cellular automaton, and the global one-step image of a finite periodic ring is a natural exact reachability invariant. Knowing forbidden factors for bi-infinite image words does not decide equal-period preimage existence: the n=1 exception makes this precise. The theorem completely resolves this mismatch for every n, supplies a constructive constant-size transfer criterion and exact rational and asymptotic state counts, and quantifies one-step information loss. It is a complete all-size result rather than an arbitrary finite census or a mere restatement of the known forbidden factors.
